core_idea: Twinhook Pirates First Mate Gregor is a Damage Dealer — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 7 Bleed (max +2).
playstyle_guide:
- Skills check **7+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Foregone Conclusion** — **S2 — Unilateral Business** adds **+3 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+4 Poise** per **Heads Hit** coin; **S1 — Negotiation Start** adds **+3 Poise** at **On Use** and **+1 Poise Count** per **On Hit** coin.
- **Foregone Conclusion** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- Manage **Ammo** — S3 spends ammo on its coin flips. Preserve **Ammo** for S3; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S1, S2 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 7 Bleed (max +2).

**S1 — Negotiation Start** (BP 4, CP +3, x2): rolls — low 4, high 10 (Extremely Low).
- Delay until 7+ Bleed on target — that is when the damage condition activates.
- Gain +1 Poise Count; [On Crit] Inflict 2 Bleed

**S2 — Unilateral Business** (BP 4, CP +6, x2): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Extremely High stacked).
- Scales Coin Power with Bleed stacks — apply liberally before committing (cap +2).
- **Coin Power** scales with **Bleed** (+1 per 7, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Gain 4 Poise; [On Crit] Inflict 2 Bleed
- Inflict 3 Bleed; [On Crit] Inflict 2 Bleed; +30% Damage on Critical Hit

**S3 — Foregone Conclusion** (BP 5, CP +6, x2): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- Gain 1 Poise for every 3 Bleed on target (Max 10); Gain Coin Power +1 for every 7 Poise on self (Max +3)
- Spend 1 Ammo; +50% Damage on Critical Hit

Combat passive — **Bullets are Pricey**: Always Active : Begin encounters with 7 Ammo.
  - On Heads Hit against targets that have Bleed, gain Unjust Enrichment. (Max 4).
  - If a Coin that uses Ammo Hits, consume all Unjust Enrichment and deal additional (25 x Unjust Enrichment consumed)% of damage dealt as bo….

Combat passive — **New Breathing Hole**: If 1 ally that has the most Poise defeats an enemy, gain 1 Pierce DMG Up next turn. (Once per turn).
